== Wrong QID: two different "William Reed" composers share one disambiguation-page QID ==

Not a Wikidata problem — Wikidata's own data is correct here; [[Q1267150]] is
correctly typed as a Wikimedia disambiguation page for the many people named
"William Reed". The bug is on our side: whatever fetch step resolved these
two composers' QIDs matched the ambiguous name straight to the disambiguation
page instead of picking the specific person, so both ended up sharing
[[Q1267150]] as their {{P|214}} (or however wikidata_id got populated) value.

Found while auditing the DB for duplicate composer rows: two rows carry the
same wikidata_id (Q1267150) but have different birth/death years (1859–1945
vs 1910–2002), which is what exposed the mismatch — a real duplicate would
have identical dates.

'''Fix needed (in this repo's DB, not on Wikidata):'''
* composers.id 2804 "William Reed" (1859–1945, Canadian organist/conductor/composer) → set wikidata_id to [[Q373961]]
* composers.id 3923 "William Reed" (1910–2002, English composer) → set wikidata_id to [[Q8017433]]

After the wikidata_id correction, re-running the usual alt-name/wikilink
backfill scripts against each corrected QID would be worth doing too, since
whatever data those fetches would have pulled from the disambiguation page
QID (if any) may be wrong or missing entirely.
